sloka: एतदाख्याय तत्सर्वं हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।भूयः समुपचक्राम वचनं वक्तुमुत्तरम् ।। ५.५९.१ ।।।।
transliteration: etadākhyāya tatsarvaṁ hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।bhūyaḥ samupacakrāma vacanaṁ vaktumuttaram ।। 5.59.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman, son of the Windgod having narrated in detail all that had happened again started disclosing further details৷৷
translations.hindi: सिर के बल दधिमुख को चरणों पर पड़ा देख सुग्रीव उद्विग्न हो बोले
